biotools.summary: deepKin is an R package that estimates genetic relatedness using a method-of-moments framework, accounting for sampling variance to enable statistical inference and classification. It's designed to improve accuracy in biobank-scale genetic studies, providing data-specific significance thresholds and power estimates.
